tagline.zh: 机器人学习与 AI 系统

bio.zh: 我是北京理工大学车辆工程硕士研究生，目前在原力灵机从事 AI Infra 实习。我的兴趣是机器人学习及其背后的数据、评测与计算系统。
bio.en: I am a master's student in Vehicle Engineering at Beijing Institute of Technology and an AI Infrastructure Intern at Dexmal. I am interested in robot learning and the data, evaluation, and computing systems that support it.

bio.zh: 近期，我参与 VLA 模型评测、训练与推理回归、机器人多模态数据采集，以及模型服务相关的工程工作。我希望通过具体实验理解系统瓶颈，让结果可检查、方法可复用。
bio.en: My recent work involves VLA evaluation, training and inference regression checks, multimodal robot data collection, and model-serving infrastructure. I use experiments to understand system bottlenecks and work toward results that can be checked and methods that can be reused.

bio.zh: 此前，我参与过轮式与四足机器人的视觉感知和端侧部署，也在本科阶段开展了采摘装备设计与轻量化视觉模型项目。
bio.en: Previously, I worked on visual perception and edge deployment for wheeled and quadruped robots. My undergraduate projects also covered harvesting equipment design and lightweight computer vision models.

note.zh: 推荐免试入学；预计 2029 年 6 月毕业。
note.en: Admitted through recommendation; expected graduation in June 2029.

description.zh: 参与具身模型的多环境评测、训推回归和结果审计，执行实验配置、运行跟进与异常分析。
description.en: Contribute to multi-environment evaluation, training and inference regression checks, and result audits for embodied models, including experiment setup, run monitoring, and failure analysis.

description.zh: 参与机器人多模态数据采集、模型服务和评测工具开发，关注数据完整性、服务可靠性与资源使用效率。
description.en: Contribute to multimodal robot data collection, model serving, and evaluation tools, with attention to data completeness, service reliability, and resource efficiency.

organization.zh: 仝人智能科技（北京）有限公司

role.zh: 机器人视觉算法实习生

description.zh: 参与局部导航视觉感知开发，开展多任务检测、相机标定、语义与深度融合，以及轮式和四足平台的接口集成。
description.en: Contributed to visual perception for local navigation, including multi-task detection, camera calibration, semantic-depth fusion, and integration with wheeled and quadruped platforms.

description.zh: 参与 Jetson Orin 上的 TensorRT 部署与推理优化，并开展 OpenVLA 部署、容器环境配置和推理链路预研。
description.en: Worked on TensorRT deployment and inference optimization on Jetson Orin, along with exploratory work on OpenVLA deployment, container environments, and inference pipelines.
